title: Identification of core genes shared by ischemic stroke and myocardial infarction using an integrated approach.
authors: Wang, Min; Gao, Yuan; Chen, Huaqiu; Cheng, Jianjie; Wang, Guangming
one_liner_zh: 该文通过转录组差异表达和PPI网络分析缺血性卒中与心梗共享核心基因，纯表达统计与湿实验验证，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Both ischemic stroke (IS) and myocardial infarction (MI) are caused by vascular occlusion that results in ischemia. While there may be similarities in their mechanisms, the potential relationship between these 2 diseases has not been comprehensively analyzed. Therefore, this study explored the commonalities in the pathogenesis of IS and MI. METHODS: Datasets for IS (GSE58294, GSE16561) and MI (GSE60993, GSE61144) were downloaded from the Gene Expression Omnibus database. Transcriptome data from each of the 4 datasets were analyzed using bioinformatics, and the differentially expressed genes (DEGs) shared between IS and MI were identified and subsequently visualized using a Venn diagram. A protein-protein interaction (PPI) network was constructed using the Interacting Gene Retrieval Tool database, and identification of key core genes was performed using CytoHubba. Gene Ontology (GO) term annotation and Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) pathway enrichment analysis of the shared DEGs were conducted using prediction and network analysis methods, and the functions of the hub genes were determined using Metascape. RESULTS: The analysis revealed 116 and 1321 DEGs in the IS and MI datasets, respectively. Of the 75 DEGs shared between IS and MI, 56 were upregulated and 19 were downregulated. Furthermore, 15 core genes - S100a12, Hp, Clec4d, Cd163, Mmp9, Ormdl3, Il2rb, Orm1, Irak3, Tlr5, Lrg1, Clec4e, Clec5a, Mcemp1, and Ly96 - were identified. GO enrichment analysis of the DEGs showed that they were mainly involved in the biological functions of neutrophil degranulation, neutrophil activation during immune response, and cytokine secretion. KEGG analysis showed enrichment in pathways pertaining to Salmonella infection, Legionellosis, and inflammatory bowel disease. Finally, the core gene-transcription factor, gene-microRNA, and small-molecule relationships were predicted. CONCLUSION: These core genes may provide a novel theoretical basis for the diagnosis and treatment of IS and MI.
abstract_zh: 背景：缺血性卒中（ischemic stroke, IS）和心肌梗死（myocardial infarction, MI）均由导致缺血的血管闭塞引起。尽管它们的机制可能存在相似之处，但这两种疾病之间的潜在关系尚未得到全面分析。因此，本研究探讨了IS和MI发病机制中的共同点。方法：从基因表达综合（Gene Expression Omnibus）数据库下载IS（GSE58294、GSE16561）和MI（GSE60993、GSE61144）的数据集。使用生物信息学方法分析4个数据集中的转录组数据，识别IS和MI共有的差异表达基因（differentially expressed genes, DEGs），并通过维恩图进行可视化。利用相互作用基因检索工具（Interacting Gene Retrieval Tool）数据库构建蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（protein-protein interaction, PPI）网络，并使用CytoHubba识别关键核心基因。采用预测和网络分析方法对共有DEGs进行基因本体论（Gene Ontology, GO）术语注释和京都基因与基因组百科全书（Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes, KEGG）通路富集分析，并使用Metascape确定枢纽基因的功能。结果：分析显示，IS和MI数据集中分别有116和1321个DEGs。IS和MI共有的75个DEGs中，56个上调，19个下调。此外，识别出15个核心基因——S100a12、Hp、Clec4d、Cd163、Mmp9、Ormdl3、Il2rb、Orm1、Irak3、Tlr5、Lrg1、Clec4e、Clec5a、Mcemp1和Ly96。DEGs的GO富集分析显示，它们主要涉及中性粒细胞脱颗粒、免疫应答期间的中性粒细胞激活以及细胞因子分泌等生物学功能。KEGG分析显示，它们富集于与沙门氏菌感染、军团菌病和炎症性肠病相关的通路中。最后，预测了核心基因-转录因子、基因-微小RNA和小分子关系。结论：这些核心基因可能为IS和MI的诊断和治疗提供新的理论基础。
